name: Merriam-Webster Dictionary
tagline: Authoritative English dictionary and thesaurus API for definitions, synonyms, and word data
description: Merriam-Webster's Dictionary API provides programmatic access to trusted English dictionary and thesaurus content, including definitions, pronunciations, etymologies, synonyms, antonyms, and example sentences. Developers get free API keys for the Collegiate Dictionary, Thesaurus, and other reference products, making it a standard choice for language tools, writing apps, and educational products.

auth.details: API key as query parameter `key`; free self-serve registration at dictionaryapi.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free only for non-commercial applications, limited to two reference APIs and 1,000 queries per day per API key/reference; commercial or higher-volume use requires a paid agreement.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial/higher-volume plans available via Merriam-Webster sales

rate_limits: 1,000 queries per API key per day; contact Merriam-Webster for higher-volume use.

example.response_snippet: [{"meta":{"id":"hello","uuid":"...","src":"collegiate","section":"alpha","stems":["hello"],"offensive":false},"hwi":{"hw":"hel*lo","prs":[{"mw":"hə-ˈlō","sound":{"audio":"hello01"}}]},"fl":"interjection","shortdef":["used as a greeting or to begin a phone conversation"]}]

use_cases: look up dictionary definition for an English word
fetch synonyms and antonyms from a thesaurus
get pronunciation and audio reference for a word
resolve word stems and alternative spellings
build spell-check or vocabulary learning features
